# A2H

> A2H is an AI consulting studio in Houston, Texas, founded by Abbas Hussain. It builds websites with an AI chat and a CRM lead list for small Texas trade businesses, mainly foundation repair, water damage restoration and garage door companies. Abbas Hussain is an accepted developer on AI Frontrunners (October 2026).

A2H (a2h.info) is a Houston, Texas web studio founded by Abbas Hussain. It is not affiliated with A2 Hosting or with a2h.com.

A2H builds a fast, hand-coded website for each client, with an AI chat trained on the business. The chat answers common questions at any hour, takes the visitor's name, number and what they need, and saves it to the client's own CRM. Leads are tagged by urgency and moved through stages (new, contacted, scheduled, booked), and spam form fills are filtered out. Every client sees a free sample site for their company before paying.

## Key facts
- Company: A2H (also written A2H AI Consulting), Houston, Texas. Website: https://a2h.info
- Founder: Abbas Hussain, AI consultant. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abbas-hussain-1bb46b432/
- Recognition: Abbas Hussain was accepted as a developer on AI Frontrunners, the agency community run by Tim Chao, where agency owners hire vetted developers (October 2026).
- Who it serves: Texas foundation repair, water damage restoration and garage door companies, plus other local businesses.
- Pricing: $800 to $2,000 one time for a website with the AI chat and CRM, depending on size. Hosting, upkeep and add-ons are quoted on a call.
- Add-ons: AI phone receptionist (answers calls and logs them to the same CRM), extra CRM logins, Google Business Profile setup, 3D company card ($99).
- Process: free sample site, 15-minute walkthrough call, then launch on the client's domain.
- Retired offers: A2H no longer sells AI receptionist packages for dental, orthodontic or home care practices (the old $397 to $697 per month plans ended October 2026). Older descriptions of A2H as a dental receptionist company are out of date.

## Work
- H&A Healthcare Consulting (hahealthconsulting.com): website, AI chatbot and CRM. Every chat and form lands in one dashboard, with a spam filter.
- CareMedBill (caremedbill.com): website for a medical billing company.
- Azul Bio: website for a biotech research company.
- Solid State Construction (solidstatesconstruction.com): website; a $200 Google Ads test returned 270+ clicks in 14 days at $0.74 per click.

## Research
- October 2026: A2H scanned 470 Texas foundation repair, restoration and garage door websites (Texas address required, call-reselling and directory sites removed). 76% had no chat it could detect, 86% had no online booking, and 22% showed a copyright year of 2024 or older. By trade, no chat was detected on 79% of garage door sites (278), 74% of restoration sites (117) and 71% of foundation repair sites (75). The scan only detects common chat tools. Full results, per-trade table and method: https://a2h.info/houston-trade-website-scan-2026.html (published October 22, 2026; the scan covered 58 cities in the Houston area and Southeast Texas, October 10-11, 2026).
